title: Episode 276: Mini AI / Cursor Update (+ Running)

sentences.en: I work more now because it is intoxicating what you are able to do with this stuff,
sentences.zh: 我现在工作得更多了，因为用这些东西能做到的事情实在太让人着迷了，

sentences.en: which is kind of like I've heard on podcasts being like, wasn't this supposed to free us from work?
sentences.zh: 这有点像我在播客里听到的那样，人们会问：这难道不是应该把我们从工作中解放出来吗？

sentences.en: And it's like, this is not work.
sentences.zh: 但事实是，这根本不是工作。

sentences.en: I am Harry Potter with the Elder One.
sentences.zh: 我简直就是拿着老魔杖的哈利·波特。

sentences.en: Welcome to ADSP, the podcast, episode 276, recorded on February 26, 2026.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听 ADSP 播客第 276 期，录制于 2026 年 2 月 26 日。

sentences.en: My name is
sentences.zh: 我是

sentences.en: Connor.
sentences.zh: Connor。

sentences.en: And today with my co-host, Bryce, we give a mini update on our AI and cursor usage, as well as chat about running and more.
sentences.zh: 今天我和我的联合主持人 Bryce 将简要更新一下我们对 AI 和 Cursor 的使用情况，并聊聊跑步以及其他话题。

sentences.en: I bought running shoes, by the way.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一下，我买了跑鞋。

sentences.en: I did buy running shoes.
sentences.zh: 我确实买了跑鞋。

sentences.en: It is better.
sentences.zh: 这样好多了。

sentences.en: You were correct that I needed to own running shoes.
sentences.zh: 你说得对，我确实需要有一双跑鞋。

sentences.en: This guy's saying his knees hurt while he's running or whatever.
sentences.zh: 这家伙说他跑步时膝盖疼什么的。

sentences.en: And I'm like, well, what kind of running shoes are you running?
sentences.zh: 我就问他：那你穿的是什么跑鞋？

sentences.en: And he's like, oh, do I need running shoes?
sentences.zh: 他说：哦，我需要跑鞋吗？

sentences.en: I'm just like, yes, you need running.
sentences.zh: 我只能说：是的，你需要跑步（装备）。

sentences.en: I guess maybe I should.
sentences.zh: 我想也许我确实应该买。

sentences.en: I'm being, what's the word, elitist about running knowledge.
sentences.zh: 我在跑步知识方面表现得有点，怎么说呢，精英主义。

sentences.en: Maybe it's not a well-known fact.
sentences.zh: 也许这不是一个广为人知的事实。

sentences.en: If you are having knee troubles, shin troubles, and you're trying to get into running, especially if you are above the age, we'll just call it 30.
sentences.zh: 如果你有膝盖或胫骨方面的困扰，并且正试图开始跑步，尤其是如果你年龄超过——我们就说是 30 岁吧。

sentences.en: I'm not saying anything about people over 30, just when you're young, it doesn't really matter.
sentences.zh: 我不是针对 30 岁以上的人，只是当你年轻时，这确实没那么重要。

sentences.en: The older you get, the more important it is.
sentences.zh: 但你年纪越大，这就越重要。

sentences.en: You need a decent pair of running shoes.
sentences.zh: 你需要一双像样的跑鞋。

sentences.en: The more cushion, the better for protecting joints and stuff.
sentences.zh: 缓冲性能越好，对关节的保护就越好。

sentences.en: And if you've had a pair for like four years, you probably need a new pair.
sentences.zh: 如果你一双鞋穿了四年左右，你可能需要换双新的了。

sentences.en: I get a new pair every like 600 kilometers.
sentences.zh: 我大概每跑 600 公里就会换一双新鞋。

sentences.en: I won't say how frequently that is, but it's pretty frequent because you want to be able to exercise and walk for a long time.
sentences.zh: 我就不说这频率有多高了，但确实挺频繁的，因为你肯定希望自己能长期坚持锻炼和行走。

sentences.en: We may not be thinking about it in our thirties, but at some point when we get to sixties, seventies, eighties, you're going
sentences.zh: 我们在三十多岁时可能不会考虑这个问题，但到了六十、七十、八十岁时，你就会

sentences.en: to start to have joint problems and the better the shoes, the longer your joints are going to work for.
sentences.zh: 开始出现关节问题，鞋子越好，你的关节就能用得越久。

sentences.en: So I, we, we did not end up doing the 5k on Valentine's day because Ramona was very sick and
sentences.zh: 所以，我们最终没能参加情人节的 5 公里跑，因为 Ramona 病得很重，而且

sentences.en: it was very cold and I could not, I could not make the sale on going through with it, but we are going to sign up for some other 5k.
sentences.zh: 天气非常冷，我实在没法坚持下去，但我们打算报名参加其他的 5 公里跑。

sentences.en: But I had, I stopped running for a little bit after the first snowstorm in New York and it's been hard for me to get back into it.
sentences.zh: 我在纽约第一场暴风雪后停跑了一段时间，现在很难重新找回状态。

sentences.en: Part of the problem is it's been too cold for Ramona to come running with me.
sentences.zh: 部分原因是天气太冷了，Ramona 没法跟我一起跑。

sentences.en: And I am not as motivated to run when my girlfriend is not there to embarrass me by running a lot faster than me.
sentences.zh: 而且当我的女朋友不在身边，没法通过跑得比我快很多来让我感到尴尬时，我跑步的动力就没那么足了。

sentences.en: So I keep telling her, you need to come back and start running with me again, because it will be better for me if like you are there to force me to, to keep going.
sentences.zh: 所以我一直告诉她，你得回来跟我一起跑，因为如果你在场逼着我继续跑，对我来说会更好。

sentences.en: You just gotta, you gotta run enough until you get addicted to it.
sentences.zh: 你只需要一直跑，直到你对它上瘾为止。

sentences.en: I have a, I have a race on Sunday called the chilly half marathon, which I've run twice before.
sentences.zh: 我周日有一场比赛叫“寒冷半马”，我之前跑过两次。

sentences.en: And it's usually been right above freezing, you know, zero degrees for Canadians, 32 for Americans, or I should say Canadians and the rest of the world.
sentences.zh: 通常气温都在冰点以上，你知道的，对加拿大人来说是 0 度，对美国人来说是 32 度，或者我应该说对加拿大人和世界其他地区的人来说。

sentences.en: And this Sunday it's supposed to be minus 12, feels like minus 18, which is gotta be like potentially below zero for Fahrenheit folks.
sentences.zh: 而这个周日预计是零下 12 度，体感零下 18 度，这对用华氏度的人来说可能也是零下。

sentences.en: And I'm very unaccented about it, but you sign up for it, you gotta do it.
sentences.zh: 我对此没什么特别的感觉，但既然报了名，就得去跑。

sentences.en: Only one time in my race have I ever missed a race.
sentences.zh: 我参加比赛以来只有一次缺席过。

sentences.en: And it's cause I was deathly ill because my nephew Franklin gave me some virus, which made it impossible to leave bed for like a couple of days.
sentences.zh: 那是因为我病得要死，我侄子 Franklin 传染给了我某种病毒，让我好几天都下不了床。

sentences.en: One of the big factors in us canceling was a misperception about the timing that I only
sentences.zh: 我们取消比赛的一个重要因素是对时间的误判，我直到最后一刻才

sentences.en: realized at the last minute, which is Ramona has been taking these acting and then these speech classes.
sentences.zh: 意识到，那就是 Ramona 一直在参加表演课和演讲课。

sentences.en: And she has one on Saturday and we signed up for the race and they said like, the starting time was like at 8am.
sentences.zh: 她周六有课，我们报名比赛时，他们说起跑时间是早上 8 点。

sentences.en: And I'm like, oh, that's great.
sentences.zh: 我就想，哦，那太好了。

sentences.en: Like 8am, 30, like a 5k.
sentences.zh: 早上 8 点，5 公里跑。

sentences.en: I'll take like, you know, like 30 minutes, you know, tops for us.
sentences.zh: 我们大概只需要，你知道，最多 30 分钟。

sentences.en: So then we'll be done and she'll have time to get to our class at noon.
sentences.zh: 这样我们跑完后，她还有时间赶去中午的课。

sentences.en: And then I realized that they don't probably don't have all the people start at the same time.
sentences.zh: 后来我意识到，他们可能不会让所有人同时起跑。

sentences.en: And we, the like very inexperienced runners are probably not starting in the first group, which is probably the like professional or very fast runners who have run a lot before.
sentences.zh: 而我们这些非常缺乏经验的跑者，可能不会在第一组起跑，第一组通常是那些专业或跑得非常快的选手。

sentences.en: So we probably would not, it would like not have been possible for us to have done that anyways, probably.
sentences.zh: 所以我们大概无论如何都不可能赶得上。

sentences.en: Yeah, that makes sense.
sentences.zh: 是啊，有道理。

sentences.en: Well, I look forward to your future race, your future times.
sentences.zh: 好吧，期待你未来的比赛和成绩。

sentences.en: And I'm glad you got running shoes.
sentences.zh: 很高兴你买了跑鞋。

sentences.en: I have a, I have a question for you.
sentences.zh: 我有个问题想问你。

sentences.en: Hey, hey, technical question, not related to our, the other stuff we have going on, which is, have you started playing around with Claude code at all yet?
